create_slab_from_bulk: create a Slab object from a Bulk object by randomly sampling a slab with given max miller index
enumerate_all_slabs: enumerate all symmetrically distinct slabs for a bulk structure up to a given max miller index
get_slabs_for_millers: get all slabs for specific Miller indices from a bulk structure with minimum tiling size
load_slabs_from_pickle: load precomputed slabs from a pickle file and filter by max miller index
compute_and_tile_slabs: compute slabs from a bulk structure, tile them to minimum size, and tag surface atoms
